item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\ncases=[\\n({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':['b']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}}},'current':{'x':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'hash':'h','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','mode':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','mode':2}},'unrelated':'changed'},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),\\n({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h'},'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'other'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]\\nfor i,(req,pol,want) in enumerate(cases):\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(i,got,want); assert req==rb and pol==pb\\nprint(json.dumps({'cases':len(cases),'status':'pass'}))\"]}"}
